name: SWEEP-S5v3 Rich and poor
_design: v3 fix (world only: map size and start points, the planned 'smaller ring' fallback). v2 (cut r44 after the 4th poor death) put rich/poor pairs on one point: they saw each other from r1 but never spoke (0 messages, 0 transfers in 44 rounds); the poor went broke r17-r23 and starved r37-r41, all 4 rich alive. Across this sweep, co-located agents never messaged, while agents that discovered another agent on a different point did greet (S7v1). v3 makes a village: a 5x5 map with the 8 agents on the 8 points around the centre, rich (400) and poor (80) alternating, so every poor agent has two rich neighbours one step away and every observe of a neighbouring point is likely to find an agent (and its tree). A tree with 1 ripe fruit on every start point plus 2 random (10 total, as v1/v2). Comm range 4 reaches the whole ring. Transfer and attack still need the same point, so giving or taking means walking one step. Everything else as v2 (vision 2, thinking ~4.3, absorption 0.3, residue 100%).
